shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone surface
repeated small motifs arranged in rows/registers
justification: A shows dense horizontal registers of small repeated script-like signs covering a flat wall, while B shows a single large anthropomorphic figure in the round with a head, shoulders, chest ornaments and a belt, plus a few discrete symbolic emblems (loops, a disc) on its body. The only real correspondence is low-relief carved motifs with some circular/looped forms; there is no shared figure type, no shared scene, and the organising principle (rows of signs versus one sculpted body) is entirely different.
